title: Existence of the two normalized finite comparisons
statement: Let d be an adic coefficient datum and sq a cartesian square with open horizontal arrows. In the strict completed-ring and finite constant-ring coordinates [def-cbc-completed-finite-exchange-coordinates], there exist natural source and target finite-comparison isomorphisms satisfying respectively CbcSourceFiniteNormalization and CbcTargetFiniteNormalization [def-cbc-finite-comparison-models], on every K-flat representative, with no boundedness, completeness or quasi-compactness condition. This statement asserts existence only.

source.place: Finite-exchange/reduction identification before Rlim; Stacks 03DI, sites-modules.tex, lemma-extension-by-zero; completed-ring strict exchange is an agent-written refinement.

proof.text: On a flat-term K-flat representative compute finite reduction by ordinary scalar extension. Exact open extension commutes with reduction through the summand tensor comparison, with every strict transition retained.

Apply the normalized finite-evaluation theorem for completed pullback to both endpoints. The constant coefficient and scalar-mate comparisons give exactly cbcSourceLevel and cbcTargetLevel on ordinary models; their tensor formulas identify the universal counits.

The comparisons are invertible on K-flat representatives. Compose the evaluated strict model map with the inverse finite model map. Naturality on chain maps and the resolving-class property descend these maps to natural isomorphisms on the derived category, preserving the stated representative equations.

proof_origin.place: Step 7, with the normalized representative equation made explicit.

from.place: Finite-exchange identification before Rlim; Step 7 of the completed-ring strict finite exchange refinement.

lean.statement:
theorem cbcNormalizedFiniteComparison_exists (n : ℕ) :
    (∃ e : completedReductionTower U d ⋙ cbcStrictOpen d j sq.isOpenImmersion ⋙
          completedTowerPullback g d ⋙ pbcTowerEvaluation X' (pbcAdicCompletion X' d) n ≅
        cbcFiniteReduction d U n ⋙ (cbcFiniteSource d sq n).mapDerivedCategory,
      CbcSourceFiniteNormalization d sq n e) ∧
    (∃ e : completedReductionTower U d ⋙ completedTowerPullback gU d ⋙
          cbcStrictOpen d j' sq.isOpenImmersion' ⋙
            pbcTowerEvaluation X' (pbcAdicCompletion X' d) n ≅
        cbcFiniteReduction d U n ⋙ (cbcFiniteTarget d sq n).mapDerivedCategory,
      CbcTargetFiniteNormalization d sq n e)
